title: pg8000 cannot authenticate against PostgreSQL 16
prompt: In /work, `python app.py` connects to the PostgreSQL 16 server running in this container and fails. Make it print `DB OK 42`. Do not change the server's configuration, its authentication method or the password: fix the client side.
error_line: pg8000.core.InterfaceError: Authentication method 10 not supported by pg8000.
